breaking_news.headline: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
breaking_news.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
breaking_news.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

breaking_news.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

breaking_news.headline: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks — and the broader markets — got pummeled this week, raising major concerns about the financial system and the wider economy. Here's what to know.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?
breaking_news.summary: Critics say now that the AI giant is a public company, its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will be tested.

breaking_news.headline: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
breaking_news.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

breaking_news.headline: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
breaking_news.summary: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.

breaking_news.headline: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Jensen's return as a national security risk.

breaking_news.headline: Prominent Zimbabwean preacher arrested on sexual assault allegations
breaking_news.summary: Uebert Angel, a British-Zimbabwean national, leads a charismatic church with branches in several countries.

breaking_news.headline: Search and rescue teams race against time to find survivors after Nigeria boat tragedy
breaking_news.summary: The government blames overcrowding, poor maintenance, and missing life jackets for boat accidents.

breaking_news.headline: India pledges $1.6bn to Nepal in reset of ties
breaking_news.summary: As Nepal rebuilds after deadly floods, its prime minister sets contentious issues aside to secure Indian funding, port access and a new train service.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
breaking_news.summary: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

breaking_news.headline: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
breaking_news.summary: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

breaking_news.headline: 'I want to destroy capitalism, not France': On the streets with the French ultra left
breaking_news.summary: The BBC meets the far-left protesters French President Emmanuel Macron says are trying to bring down the Republic.

breaking_news.headline: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
breaking_news.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

breaking_news.headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, Zelensky says
breaking_news.summary: The Kremlin warns of an "escalation of tensions in the region", but declines to comment directly on the attacks in Libya.

breaking_news.headline: Catering giant to switch main share listing to US in further blow to UK
breaking_news.summary: A growing number of firms have been leaving the UK to list shares in the US in recent years.

breaking_news.headline: Next data accessed in cyber breach
breaking_news.summary: The fashion retailer says there is no evidence customers' personal data was compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Capita shares plunge 70% as boss quits after civil service pensions failure
breaking_news.summary: Public sector workers have been hit by delays to pension payments, in a scheme overseen by Capita since last year.

breaking_news.headline: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
breaking_news.summary: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
